context: Pure deletion PR. Before deleting, grep the whole repo (including docs, _project, results-explorer) for each symbol to confirm zero live references beyond the re-exports and own tests. If docs/reference/mcp.md or public-contracts mention the symbols, update in the same change.
description: Remove dead code identified in the 2026-08-04 review. (1) benchbox/mcp/execution.py (428 lines): ExecutionTracker/ExecutionState/run_benchmark_async are referenced only by tests/unit/mcp/test_execution.py and the lazy __getattr__ re-export at benchbox/mcp/__init__.py:172-179; no tool or server path uses them -- superseded by jobs.py's durable queue. It also contains a duplicate _get_platform_adapter (execution.py:289) that ignores mode. (2) benchbox/mcp/observability.py (333 lines): ToolCallContext/get_metrics_collector only re-exported lazily (__init__.py:168-171), imported by no tool module. (3) benchbox/mcp/schemas.py:789-1007: Pydantic input models (RunBenchmarkInput, DryRunInput, ValidateConfigInput, GetBenchmarkInfoInput, ListRecentRunsInput, GetResultsInput, CompareResultsInput, ExportSummaryInput) not wired into any registered tool, referencing tool names that no longer exist and encoding stale defaults (ValidateConfigInput.scale_factor=1.0 vs live 0.01). Delete modules, their tests, and the lazy re-exports.

anti_patterns.dont: delete the whole of schemas.py's model section by line range
anti_patterns.instead: delete exactly the orphaned classes after confirming each is unreferenced
anti_patterns.why: validate_platform_options and the allowlist constants in the same file are live security code

anti_patterns.dont: keep the dead modules 'just in case' behind deprecation shims
anti_patterns.instead: delete outright; git history preserves them
anti_patterns.why: the one-engine program replaces this layer; shims would be migrated for nothing

preserves.behavior: Public import surface: importing benchbox.mcp must keep working; only the dead lazy attrs are removed.
core's ExecutionContext (benchbox/core/schemas.py) is a different symbol from mcp ExecutionState -- do not confuse the two.
jobs.py durable queue, telemetry.py, and the live validate_platform_options path in schemas.py are untouched.

prior_art.concept: The durable job queue that superseded execution.py's in-memory tracker
Live telemetry middleware that superseded observability.py
